reference: Source draw dimensions and anchors are gameplay design units; image dimensions are pixels. All geometry renders screen-parallel without vanishing points.

ground.notes: Flat terrain decal; no height/parallax invented.

frontage.notes: Existing shop screen rect 89x236 is code-verified. Roof/top face styling requires visual approval.

bridge.notes: Footprints from PR4 are fixed; masonry projected height requires sign-off.

freestanding.notes: Ground anchored vertical prop; silhouette only, no approved physical camera pitch.

templates.name: Victorian frontage
templates.style: British painted near-front shop elevation, copy top-face/roof exposure from the original first-biome shop atlas exactly; screen-parallel facade, no narrowing or invented 3D volume.

templates.name: Stone bridge pier
templates.style: Rounded red-brown brick pier with light stone cap; no water, grass, deck or baked ground.

templates.name: Victorian lamppost
templates.style: Cast-iron roadside lamp, silhouette and visible faces derived from the existing painted first-biome freestanding prop convention, not a new 3D view; preserve original lighting and low-detail gameplay readability.

templates.name: Ground surface decal
templates.style: Ground plane painted moss and small stones, no extrusion or environment background.

templates.name: Bridge deck — seamless straight tile
templates.style: Paint existing first-biome paving materials onto a uniform 84-game-unit-wide deck section. Strictly PARALLEL sides x138 and x222 for its entire length, horizontal stone joints, no convergence or one-piece bridge illustration. Tile repeats vertically; no rails, water, banks, horizon, shadows or vegetation outside the measured silhouette.

templates.name: Bridge left parapet — straight segment
templates.style: ONLY the left 17-unit brick parapet segment with stone coping, no deck or river. Constant apparent width, perfectly straight vertical game-scroll direction, material and outline sampled from original high-street brick fronts, no tilted 3D extrusion, no light/shadow baked on ground. Tile end to end.

templates.name: Bridge right parapet — straight segment
templates.style: ONLY the right 17-unit brick parapet segment with stone coping, no deck or river. Constant apparent width, perfectly straight vertical game-scroll direction, material and outline sampled from original high-street brick fronts, no tilted 3D extrusion, no light/shadow baked on ground. Tile end to end. Do not mirror incompatible asymmetric art.

street.description: Actual 360x640 first-biome daylight game render with debug demonstration placements. QA evidence only, not an owner-approved first-30-second style master.

bridge.description: Chromium real-engine bridge review capture, not approved art.

wilderness.description: Real-engine wilderness review capture, not approved art.
